model: ASCO Power Manager Xp via BASgatewayLX
applies_to: ASCO Power Manager Xp metering modules on ASCO transfer switches, read over Modbus by a BASgatewayLX.
summary: Gateway profile for the ASCO Power Manager Xp: 356 objects (110 AI, 98 AO, 44 BI, 104 BO), all polled. It reads phase and average voltages, currents, kW, kVAR, kVA and PF, frequency, normal and emergency kWh/kVARh, demand, switch positions, digital inputs and the 12 setpoint alarm states; outputs set nominal ratings, digital outputs, the clock and alarm acknowledges.
notes: Built from Contemporary Controls' BASgatewayLX Modbus device profile Asco_Power_Manage_Xp_a_LX.csv; the profile maps the registers in the ASCO Power Manager Modbus register list (https://www.ccontrols.com/support/dp/Asco_Power_Mgr.pdf).
Object instances are the ones this profile assigns when it is loaded into the gateway. A site that edited or rebuilt the profile may use different instances.
All 356 rows are flagged for polling in the profile, so every object is served to BACnet once the profile is loaded.

The CSV has no read/write column: Analog/Binary Inputs are read-only and Analog/Binary Outputs are commandable (priority array), which is how the gateway maps them (access inferred). Descriptions give the Modbus register each object reads.
Some names appear more than once in the profile as published (Line to line average voltage; Average current; Active Power total...); they are kept as printed and told apart by instance.

integration.summary: Read the electrical totals, the normal and emergency energy registers and the switch position word.
setup: The BASgatewayLX presents each Modbus device as its own virtual BACnet device on BACnet IP; give it a unique device instance and Modbus address (serial) or IP address (Modbus TCP) when you add it with this profile.
One BASgatewayLX handles up to 100 Modbus devices and 1000 polled points in total, so leave unneeded rows unpolled.
gotchas: Nominal voltage/current/kW/frequency outputs (AO 41-44) are meter setup values; don't write them cyclically.
